column1: # flags.tsv — the feature-flag registry (owner and removal name the tickets).
# Tab-separated: name default kind owner removal expires description
#   default  on | off     kind  feature | content
#   owner    the ticket that adds the flag   removal  the sub-task that deletes it
#   expires  YYYY-MM-DD; scripts/ci/check-flags.sh fails CI once it has passed (14 days from birth)
# A flag is read only through scripts/lib/flags.sh, flags.py or flags.mjs, and never under
# scripts/hooks/, in a gate script or on a ci-trust-paths.txt path (docs/internals/config-layers.md).

column7: next-dispatchable.sh lists To Do tickets of one version that share files as one SERIES row, and marks a candidate colliding only with a live series worker STACKABLE; off keeps today's output
chief-wait.sh hands every new READY bullet of a manifest worker to worker-event.sh once, which runs auto-go.sh live (writes and sends the GO); off keeps ESCALATE marker-READY

gen-briefs projects a worker PR size from its Writes and, with the flag on, refuses a brief past the 40-file hard max of pr-size-bands.tsv unless the worker carries bulk: mechanical; off keeps a warning only
